title: Etwa 50.000 Hitzetote im Sommer 2026 in Europa

teaser: Case filed in 2022 by patient unable to afford medicine leads to cap on drug prices for millions who face ruin if diagnosed The Indian government has moved to reduce the price of cancer drugs after a retired bank clerk took her case to the supreme court. From next month, 137 cancer drugs in India will be cheaper as the government tries to tackle the tragedy of poorer patients either forgoing treatment, selling land or falling into debt to meet the high cost of some medicines, which are making large profits for hospitals and pharmacists. title: India slashes cost of cancer drugs after court rules mark-ups are ‘extortion’

teaser: Take a selfie to see how healthy you are: the idea is enticing and this new research is promising. AI is getting better at spotting patterns in medical data, but can it be used to reliably predict what will happen to an individual patient? I asked a clinical colleague what she thought about the recent headlines . She found it an interesting development given that doctors have long used facial appearance to assess patient health. For…
title: Can AI really predict cancer survival better than a doctor? I have my doubts | Devi Sridhar
